# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Sentra is an authentication framework, so security issues are taken seriously.

If you discover a potential security vulnerability in Sentra, please do not open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, report the vulnerability privately by contacting:

**[bisht26akash@gmail.com](mailto:bisht26akash@gmail.com)**

Please include:

* A description of the vulnerability
* The affected version(s)
* Steps to reproduce the issue
* The potential security impact
* Any suggested mitigation or fix, if available

Please allow reasonable time for the issue to be investigated and addressed before publicly disclosing the vulnerability.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.0.x   | Yes       |

Older versions may not receive security fixes.

## Security Updates

Security fixes will be documented in the changelog and released as appropriate.

For significant vulnerabilities, users may be notified through the project's GitHub repository and npm package releases.
